fusions.name: Spade Swing
fusions.desc: A flat swing that deals 15 damage and knocks the target back 3 tiles, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tremor Shuffle
fusions.desc: Stamps and shakes the ground, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Pitfall
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to dig a pit that stays armed for 30 seconds. The first enemy to come within 2 tiles of it falls in and takes 16 damage.

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: After you cover a stretch of ground, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
